/Users/fernando/Documents/Aulas/web2-2026-1/aprenda-go-com-testes/2-hello-world/hello.go
func getRegionalVocative(region string) string {
	switch region {
	case RegionRN:
		return "boy"
	case RegionSP:
		return "mano"
	case RegionMG:
		return "sô"
	case RegionRS:
		return "tchê"
	default:
		return "" // sem vocativo regional
	}
}
